tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ni gu'i yan lag lus sems 'chi med kyi khrid bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ 'dir nying khu'i yan lag lus sems 'chi med man ngag gi kha bskangs te nyams su len pa la 'khrul 'khor sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis rtsa thig rlung gsum sbyangs nas/ gdan bde ba la lus gnad tsog pu skyil krung gang bde byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams sngon du btang nas 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ 'chi zhes pa 'di lus 'chi'am sems 'chi/ lus 'chi'o snyam na/ rnam smin gyi lus 'di 'chi'am bag chags kyi lus 'chi/ dang po ltar yang min te lus 'di sha khrag rgyus pa lpags pa sogs tshogs pa'i bem po kho na yin pas de la 'chi ba ga la yod/ yod na rdo sogs kyang ci'i phyir mi 'chi/ bag chags kyi lus kyang mi 'chi ste/ 'chi na rmi lam du shi bas 'chi ba'i go chod dgos/ de ltar na rmi lam du shi ba rmis pa'i gang zag de dag gnyid mi sad dgos te shi zin pas so snyam du bsam zhing / mdor na sngon gyi las kyi 'phen pa zad nas rnam smin gyi lus 'di la sems ma gnas pa tsam la 'chi ba zhes brtags pa yin gyi 'chi ba zhes pa don la ma grub bo zhes bsam zhing lus 'chi med du nam gtan la 'bebs 'bebs bsgom par bya'o/ /sems 'di 'chi'o snyam na de la sems 'chi med rang 'grol zhes bya ba'i gdams pa khyad par can 'di nyams su len pa la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas rang skad cig gis padma nyi ma 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i steng du/ 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog sngon po zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma'i lto ba mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo bltabs nas mnan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum ldan zhal 'gyur zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa'i thor lcog spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor rin po che/ g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla ba 'tshog ma'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rje phyag gnyis kyis rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo g.yas gri gug gis gdug pa can sdigs shing / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa gcer bu spyan gsum skra grol ba/ sku sha rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ rus rgyan lnga ldan zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa gcig gsal bar sgoms/ de'i spyi bor bla ma bsgom la gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas nyams len la 'jug pa la gsum ste/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ yab kyi spyi bo'i skra mtshams su lha sku shin tu gsal ba de yang mgo bo so sor byed pa'i hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer 'phro ba gcig bsam/ de nas hūm̐ las 'od byung bas smin mtshams yan chad gsal sing song / de nas shangs yan spyan rtsa tshun gsal ba'i spyan gsum hrig hrig pa/ de nas rim bzhin mgrin pa/ thugs kha lte ba gsang gnas kyi sbyor mtshams yan chad/ de nas pus mo long bu sor mo'i sen mo phan chad gsal sing ba byung byung bsgom/ yab kyi phyi sbyangs pa'o/ /de nas yang hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung tshangs bug na mar song bas shangs dang mgrin pa yan chad sngo sang song / de nas thugs kha lte ba gsang gnas pus mo long bu sor mo'i nang yan chad sngo sing ba 'od kyi rang bzhin du bsgom/ yab kyi nang sbyangs pa'o/ /de bzhin du yum gyi spyi bo'i steng gi skra mtshams su baṃ dmar po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba gcig bsam/ de las 'od zer dmar po byung gong bzhin yum gyi phyi nang gnyis su sbyangs khyad par bha ga dang nu ma dmar sang nge bsgoms pa ni kha dog gsal 'debs so/ /de nas yab kyi spyan dbus ma nas rim bzhin gsal 'debs/

ral pa'i thor lcog rdor dril 'dzin lugs/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa zhabs kyi 'chang stabs sgeg pa me dpung la sogs pa de re re nas gsal 'debs pa ni dbyibs bsgom pa'o/ /de bzhin du yum la yang dbyibs re re nas bsgom/ de nas yab kyi spyi bo'i nor bu zla phyed sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo rna cha mgul rgyan/ gdu bu ske rags thal chen re rus pa'i rgyan drug mi mgo skam rlon gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal/ yum la'ang thal chen ma gtogs pa'i rus rgyan lnga mgo skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal sogs rim bzhin bsgoms pa ni rgyan gsal 'debs so/ /de lta bu'i yab yum gnyis ka gsal stong bde chen zung 'jug rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba gcig bsgom/ de yang gsal ba'i ngo bo nas ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa stong pa'i ngo bo nas rang bzhin gang du yang ma grub pa 'od kyi rang bzhin du bsam la/ 'di lta bu 'di rang gi sems nyid lha skur snang ba ma gtogs de las logs su phyi rol gyi don du bden par ma grub par thag bcad de bsgom/ des rmi lam dang chu zla bzhin de yang rmi lam du yul sna tshogs zhig rmis kyang / yul gyis tshur 'ong ba yang med/ rang sems kyis phar phyin pa yang med/ sems nyid kyis bslad pa'i dbang gis sems nyid sna tshogs su snang ba yin gyi de las logs su bden par grub pa med do/ /des chu nang gi zla ba las shes so/ /de bzhin du rang sems 'od gsal lha sku shin tu gsal ba de gang nas byon gang du bzhugs/ gang na gnas brtags pas gang nas kyang ma byon gang du yang mi bzhugs/ gar yang mi gnas par gsal stong zung 'jug spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar thag gcad/ de 'dra'i rang sems lha sku dang dbyer med pa'i sangs rgyas 'das pa rnams kyis kyang ma gzigs/ ma byon pa rnams kyis kyang gzigs par mi 'gyur/ da lta rnams kyis kyang ma gzigs so snyam du bsgom mo/

/gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ sems gsal stong rang bzhin ma grub pa 'di 'chi med du bsgom pa la 'chi med sems kyi dmigs pa bzhi las/ dang po ni de ltar dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis ma gzigs pa'i rang sems gsal stong de la na ba ma grub ste/ na bar snang ba de rang gi las nyon glo bur ba des bslad pa'i snang ba yin gyi don dam la na ba'i rgyu med de med pas 'bras bu na ba yang med do snyam sems na med du rtogs rtogs bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa ni de 'dra ba'i sems 'chi ba ma grub ste 'chi ba zhes pa lus bem po 'di dang rnam rtog glo bur ba de bral ba la brtags pa tsam yin gyi/ brtags shing dpyad na 'pho bya 'pho byed dang bral ba gang du yang mi bden pa'i stong nyid du nam thag ma chod bar du bsgom mo/ /gsum pa ni de 'dra ba'i sems de las 'tshang rgya rgyu 'dug gam mi 'dug bltas pas 'tshang rgya rgyu med do/ /sems kyi dus dang sangs rgyas pa'i dus kyi sems kyi rang bzhin gnyis 'od gsal stong nyid du dbyer med do/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag de glo bur gyi dri ma thams cad dang bral ba de la sangs rgyas zhes ming btags pa tsam yin no snyam du bsgom mo/ /bzhi pa ni de 'dra'i lha sku rang sems gsal stong de'i rang bzhin la bsams na 'khor ba ma grub ste/ 'khor ba bden par ma grub pas 'khor bar 'khor mkhan ma grub snyam du 'khor ba rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang bar thag nam chod chod bsgom mo/ /gsum pa rjes ni de ltar rang sems 'chi med du thag bcad de nges shes bskyed la yengs med du bsgom/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa sems can la snying rje bsgom pa/ dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs byang du bsngo bas bogs 'don na/ mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang 'chi kha'am/ bar dor 'tshang rgya na sgrib pa chung zhing skal ba dang ldan pa ni rgyun du sgom pa lta zhog

'chi khar sku yongs rdzogs sam cha shas tsam gsal bas kyang sgyogs kyi 'khrul 'khor ram ngang pa'i rdzing du rdo brgyab pa'am/ tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma rgas pa dang zla ba 'char ba dus mnyam bzhin du bar dor rgyal ba longs skur 'tshang rgya ste/ chos sku las ma g.yos par gzugs sku gnyis kyi gang la gang 'dul gyi sems can gyi don lhun grub rgyun chad med par byed do/ /de lta bu'i gdams ngag med par lam bsgrub pa'i rtsol ba cher byas kyang / chu bsrubs kyang mar mi 'byung ba bzhin du ngal ba don med yin zhing / 'di 'dra ba'i gdams ngag dang ldan zhing nyams su len pa de ni mdo rgyud thams cad kyi bcud phyung nas bsdus pas/ las nyon 'khrul pa'i gcong nad bsal nas mkha' spyod du 'gro nges pa'i gdams pa yin pas nyams su len dgos so/ /'di bas zab pa'i man ngag rgya bod gnyis na med pa yin no/ /pho grung mo grung brtson 'grus can tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i chos lags so/ /'di dag gi rigs pas lus bem po 'di sems gsal stong gnyis ka 'khor ba nas sangs rgyas su 'chug mi 'chug sangs rgyas nas 'khor ba/ ngan 'gro nas bde 'gro sogs su 'chug mi 'chug bltas la/ lus dang sems 'chug med du thag chod chod bsgom mo/ /snying rus can tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i chos/ nying khu'i yan lag gi chos skor las 'chi med dang 'chug med kyi dmigs rim gsal ba 'di yang lung stong smyon pas mkha' 'gro'i gsung bzhin nyams su myong bar byas nas gnas mchog ri bo cher stag lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad nas bdun pa'i bco lnga'i bar la nying khu'i lus yan dang bcas pa tshang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa bka' bcu pa blo gros rgyal mtshan yin/ ༈ dam chos 'di tshul bzhin nyams su len pa la/ tshe 'dis 'khri ba bcad pas don chen grub nas gtan gyi byus legs 'gro ba 'dug pas so/ /thams cad kyis rtsol ba skyed la rem//
